formatInfo.title: File Format
formatInfo.description: Testownik supports questions in plain text format (.txt). Each file represents one question. The file structure should look like this:
formatInfo.line1Desc: Consists of a category letter (e.g. X) and a sequence of zeros and ones. 1 means correct answer, 0 means wrong. E.g. X0100 means the second answer is correct.
formatInfo.line2Desc: The text of the question. You can embed an image here using the [img]filename.png[/img] tag.
formatInfo.line3Desc: Each subsequent line is an answer variant. Their count must match the length of the binary mask (zeros and ones).

privacyModal.title: Privacy Policy
privacyModal.section1Text: The Testownik application stores your question decks and study progress locally on your device (in browser storage via IndexedDB). When using login and synchronization features (including cloud backup and leaderboards), basic profile data (username, avatar) and statistics (XP gained, completed sessions) are securely transmitted and stored in our database (Supabase).
privacyModal.section2Text: In live race mode, question decks and images are transferred directly between peer devices via Peer-to-Peer technology (WebRTC). Your IP addresses may be briefly visible to signaling servers (STUN) to establish connection, but no question contents or images in this mode are stored on our servers.
privacyModal.section3Text: Collected data is solely used to:
privacyModal.section3Item1: Ensure proper operation of the app and sync your progress.
privacyModal.section3Item2: Display your position on the global leaderboard.
privacyModal.section4Text: We use modern database security standards (Row Level Security) to ensure unauthorized parties cannot access your sensitive data. We do not share or sell your data to third parties.
